abstract: PURPOSE: This retrospective review was done to assess the prognosis and response in patients presenting with primitive neuroectodermal tumor admixed with germ cell tumor. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Of the 40 patients treated at our institution from 1984 to 1999, 15 had initial stage I and 25 had initial metastatic disease. Median followup after the diagnosis was 25 months (range 4 to 142). RESULTS: Of the 40 patients 15 presented with clinical stage I disease, including 9 treated with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and 6 who elected surveillance. Seven of the 9 patients had normal lymph nodes and all continuously had no evidence of disease. Two of the 9 patients had lymph nodes involved with teratoma with or without primitive neuroectodermal tumor. Retroperitoneal relapse in 5 of the 6 patients on surveillance was treated with cisplatin based chemotherapy followed by post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Residual primitive neuroectodermal tumor was noted in 4 of the 5 patients and only 3 of 6 are currently without disease at a median followup of 17 months (range 15 to 69). A total of 25 patients presented with metastatic disease, of whom 23 underwent cisplatin based chemotherapy. Only 3 patients achieved complete remission with chemotherapy alone and 2 of the 3 subsequently relapsed. Of the remaining 20 patients 16 underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, including 11 with primitive neuroectodermal tumor in the resected specimen. Two of these 11 patients have continuously had no evidence of disease, while an additional 3 currently have no evidence of disease after further therapy. Teratoma was present in the resected specimen in 5 of 16 patients, of whom 2 have continuously had no evidence of disease, while an additional 2 currently have no evidence of disease after further surgical resection. Therefore, 11 of 25 patients who presented with metastatic disease currently have no evidence of disease at a median followup of 19 months (range 2 to 111). CONCLUSIONS: Primitive neuroectodermal tumor in the orchiectomy specimen has adverse prognostic significance. This condition in the retroperitoneum is potentially curable by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection but rarely eradicated by chemotherapy. Therefore, we recommend retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for all clinical stage I cases with primitive neuroectodermal tumor in the orchiectomy specimen. Patients who present with metastatic primitive neuroectodermal tumor should be treated aggressively with surgical resection as an integral part of the therapeutic strategy.
abstract_ja: 目的：胚細胞腫瘍に混在する原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍を有する患者の予後と治療反応を評価すること。材料と方法：1984年から1999年に当施設で治療された40例を後方視的に検討した。このうち15例は初診時に臨床病期Iであり、25例は転移性疾患であった。診断後のフォローアップ期間の中央値は25か月（範囲4〜142か月）であった。結果：臨床病期Iの15例のうち、9例は後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、6例は監視療法を選択した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた9例のうち7例はリンパ節が正常で、全例が無病状態を継続した。残る2例はリンパ節に奇形腫（原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍の有無を問わず）の浸潤を認めた。監視療法を受けた6例中5例に後腹膜再発が生じ、シスプラチン併用化学療法の後、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。その5例中4例で残存原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍が認められ、中央値17か月（範囲15〜69か月）のフォローアップ時点で無病であるのは6例中3例のみであった。転移性疾患を呈した25例のうち23例がシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた。化学療法単独で完全寛解に至ったのは3例のみで、そのうち2例が後に再発した。残る20例のうち16例が化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、切除標本に原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍を認めたのは11例であった。切除標本に奇形腫を認めたのは16例中5例で、そのうち2例は継続して無病であり、さらに2例はさらなる外科的切除の後に現在無病である。したがって転移性疾患の25例中11例が、中央値19か月（範囲2〜111か月）の時点で現在無病である。結論：精巣摘除標本中の原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍は予後不良因子である。後腹膜に生じたこの病態は後腹膜リンパ節郭清により根治の可能性があるが、化学療法で根治することはまれである。したがって、精巣摘除標本に原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍を認める臨床病期Iの全症例に対して後腹膜リンパ節郭清を推奨する。転移性の原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍を有する患者は、外科的切除を治療戦略の不可欠な一部として積極的に治療すべきである。
